answer.because: The last run is -348 with two XL stop losses, but the script locks the take profit to the entry bar because strategy.exit is sent only on the entry bar. Resend the exit every bar so long_limit and short_limit move with close.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout colored Back ground Good Copy Redesign 2", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000, max_boxes_count=500)

// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(5, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)

long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv

if strategy.position_size != 0
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== PROFILE INPUTS =====
profile_lookback = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows     = input.int(20, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5)

// ===== TREND INPUTS =====
vwma_len       = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1)
vwma_slope_len = input.int(5, "VWMA Slope Lookback (bars)", minval=1)
min_slope      = input.float(0.5, "Min VWMA Slope (pts)", minval=0.0)

// ===== DELTA INPUT =====
min_delta_pct = input.float(3.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5)

// ===== ENTRY PARAMETERS =====
hold_bars        = input.int(2, "Hold Bars", minval=1, maxval=10)
arm_expire_bars  = input.int(20, "Arm Expire Bars", minval=1, maxval=100)
cooldown_bars    = input.int(10, "Cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=100, step=1)

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn

int sess_start = 1800
int sess_end   = 1600

bool in_session = (sess_start > sess_end) ? (bar_t >= sess_start or bar_t < sess_end) : (bar_t >= sess_start and bar_t < sess_end)

prev_hr = hour(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_mn = minute(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_t  = prev_hr * 100 + prev_mn
bool was_in_session = (sess_start > sess_end) ? (prev_t >= sess_start or prev_t < sess_end) : (prev_t >= sess_start and prev_t < sess_end)

bool session_ended = was_in_session and not in_session

if session_ended and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

// ===== POSITION EXIT =====
if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== VWMA TREND =====
float vwma_val   = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
float vwma_slope = vwma_val - vwma_val[vwma_slope_len]
bool  vwma_up    = vwma_slope > min_slope
bool  vwma_dn    = vwma_slope < -min_slope

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== FILTERS =====
bool delta_bull = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct
bool delta_bear = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct

bool in_poc_zone = not na(poc_lo) and not na(poc_hi) and close >= poc_lo and close <= poc_hi

// ===== ARM & ENTRY LOGIC =====
var int armed_dir     = 0
var int arm_start_bar = 0
var int consecutive_holds = 0
var int last_entry_bar = -9999

bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_entry_bar >= cooldown_bars
bool can_enter = in_session and strategy.position_size == 0 and cooled_down

bool long_hold_cond = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and vwma_up and delta_bull
bool short_hold_cond = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and vwma_dn and delta_bear

if armed_dir == 0
    if long_hold_cond
        armed_dir := 1
        arm_start_bar := bar_index
        consecutive_holds := 1
    else if short_hold_cond
        armed_dir := -1
        arm_start_bar := bar_index
        consecutive_holds := 1
else if armed_dir == 1
    bool expired = bar_index - arm_start_bar >= arm_expire_bars
    if in_poc_zone or expired
        armed_dir := 0
        consecutive_holds := 0
    else
        if long_hold_cond
            consecutive_holds += 1
        else
            consecutive_holds := 0
        
        if consecutive_holds >= hold_bars and can_enter
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
            last_entry_bar := bar_index
            armed_dir := 0
            consecutive_holds := 0
else if armed_dir == -1
    bool expired = bar_index - arm_start_bar >= arm_expire_bars
    if in_poc_zone or expired
        armed_dir := 0
        consecutive_holds := 0
    else
        if short_hold_cond
            consecutive_holds += 1
        else
            consecutive_holds := 0
            
        if consecutive_holds >= hold_bars and can_enter
            strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
            last_entry_bar := bar_index
            armed_dir := 0
            consecutive_holds := 0

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", vwma_up ? color.lime : vwma_dn ? color.red : color.gray, linewidth=2)

float plo  = not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na
float ppoc = not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na
float phi  = not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na

plot_lo  = plot(plo, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot_poc = plot(ppoc, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot_hi  = plot(phi, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

color channel_fill = na
if not na(poc_delta_pct)
    if poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct
        channel_fill := color.new(color.green, 90)
    else if poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct
        channel_fill := color.new(color.red, 90)
    else
        channel_fill := color.new(color.gray, 95)

fill(plot_lo, plot_hi, channel_fill)

plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? (strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv) : na, "Stop", color.fuchsia, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

plotshape(armed_dir == 1 and consecutive_holds >= hold_bars and can_enter, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(armed_dir == -1 and consecutive_holds >= hold_bars and can_enter, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)

plot(not na(poc_delta_pct) ? poc_delta_pct : na, "POC Delta %", color.orange, display=display.data_window)
